title: Crash on startup when the config path contains unicode characters
body:
acme-cli 2.4.1 on Windows 11.

Steps:
1. Put the config in `C:\Users\Zoë\acme\config.toml`
2. Run `acme status`

Expected: status output. Actual: it crashes.

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "acme/config.py", line 88, in load
UnicodeDecodeError: 'charmap' codec can't decode byte 0x81
```

comments.body: Same here with a Cyrillic username.
+1, unicode path in config crashes on startup for me too

title: Login token is printed in debug logs
body: acme-cli 2.4.1. Steps: 1. run `acme login --debug`. Expected: token redacted. Actual: the full bearer token appears in the debug log output.

title: Progress bar flickers in Windows Terminal
body: Version 2.3.0. Steps: run `acme sync` in Windows Terminal. Expected a steady progress bar, actual it flickers. No error output.

title: Data loss: sync deletes local files when the remote folder is empty
body:
Regression in 2.4.0, 2.3.2 was fine.

1. Create an empty remote folder
2. `acme sync ./photos remote:empty`

Expected: nothing deleted. Actual: all local files under ./photos were deleted. Log:
```
INFO deleting 214 files not present on remote
```

comments.body: Any workaround until the fix ships?

title: Docs: the example for --filter is wrong
body: The docs page for `acme list` shows `--filter name=foo` but the flag expects `--filter name:foo`.
